Frequently asked questions

What is LegalZoom Virtual Mail and how does it work?

Virtual Mail is a service that digitizes your incoming physical mail so you can manage it entirely online. When you sign up, you receive a virtual business address, which is a real street address at a physical location where trained technicians receive and sort your items. Each piece of mail is scanned into a high-resolution PDF and uploaded to your digital mailbox, allowing you to read, manage, or shred your correspondence from any device, anywhere in the world.

What is the difference between a virtual address and a virtual mailbox?

LegalZoom offers both a virtual address and a virtual mailbox. While often used interchangeably, these terms represent different service levels within a virtual mail service.

Virtual address: Primarily provides ownership of a professional virtual mail address for marketing or business registration. This is ideal for those who don't expect much mail, as scanning is often handled à la carte. 

Virtual mailbox: Includes a virtual address but adds comprehensive virtual mail processing. Technicians scan the interior and exterior of all mail so you can view and manage it online.

What are the differences between a virtual mailbox and a USPS P.O. Box?

Access: A mailbox online is accessible 24/7 from any device, whereas a USPS P.O. Box requires a physical trip to the post office, which is only available during business hours.

Carrier acceptance: A virtual mail address at a street location accepts packages from all carriers, including FedEx, UPS, and DHL, while a standard P.O. Box typically only receives USPS mail.

Professionalism: Using a real street address on business cards and websites looks more professional than a P.O. Box.

State registration: In the majority of states, you can’t use a P.O. Box to register an LLC, corporation, or partnership because a business address must be a physical street address.

Can I use a virtual mailbox for LLC registration or other business registration?

Yes, you can use a virtual mailbox for LLC registration and other business registration purposes in most states to meet physical address requirements. A business virtual address is superior to a P.O. Box for this purpose, as many states do not allow a P.O. Box for official business registration. While it serves as your public-facing address, you must still maintain a registered agent to receive legal service of process.

Is a digital mailbox safe and secure?

Yes, a digital mailbox offers high security. Mail is processed at secure, access-controlled facilities by background-checked technicians. Scanned documents are protected by encryption and password-protected cloud storage, while unwanted physical mail is securely shredded and recycled on-site.

Can a virtual mail service deposit checks for my business?

Yes, many virtual mail plans include a check-depositing feature. LegalZoom has a check-depositing service that can be added for an additional fee. We can mail your checks directly to your bank for deposit into your business bank account.

Why should I use a virtual address instead of my home address?

Privacy: It helps keep your residential address more private, protecting you from identity theft and unwanted visitors. 

Professionalism: A commercial street address builds credibility and trust with clients who may be wary of a home-based business.

Can I receive packages from FedEx, UPS, and DHL at a virtual address?

Yes, you can receive shipments from all major carriers—including FedEx, UPS, DHL, and USPS—at your virtual mail address. Once a package arrives, you will be notified via your digital mailbox, where you can manage the item and request to have it forwarded to a domestic or international address of your choice.

Do I have to physically pick up my mail or packages?

No, you cannot physically pick up your mail or packages at LegalZoom Virtual Mail addresses. Our service is entirely virtual, which means you do not have access to the physical locations associated with your mailing address. Instead, we offer convenient options for managing your mail and packages remotely.

Can I have multiple virtual business addresses?

Yes, you can sign up for multiple addresses to establish a presence in various cities or regions. This allows you to scale your business across states or countries and target different markets while managing all correspondence through a single online mailbox account.

What types of businesses benefit most from a virtual mail service?

Any business seeking to separate personal and professional affairs, maintain a credible image without a physical office, or manage correspondence remotely benefits from virtual mail. It is particularly valuable for:

Home-based businesses: Protects personal privacy by keeping residential addresses off public records.

Remote & hybrid teams: Provides a central digital hub for employees located across the country or the world.

Digital nomads & frequent travelers: Ensures 24/7 global access to searchable, high-resolution PDF mail via a digital mailbox.

Startups & international firms: Allows companies to establish a prestigious presence in new markets—such as Park Avenue in New York City—without high real estate costs.

Professional services: Independent law firms, finance startups, and luxury retail brands use it to maintain a high-profile commercial virtual address.
